programme.title: Brutalist
programme.desc: Holokausti küüsist pääsenud arhitekt jõuab Uude Maailma ja hakkab püüdlema omaenda Ameerika unelma poole. Lugu Ungari juudi päritolu arhitektist Laszlo Tothist, kes pärast holokausti üleelamist emigreerub USAsse et alustada uut elu, oodates päeva mil saabuks tema Ida Euroopasse lõksu jäänud naine Erzsebet. See mida Lászlo läände saabudes leiab on hoopis teistsugune Ameerika kui ta ootas.

programme.title: Kuidas Grinch jõulud varastas
programme.desc: USA-Saksamaa 2000 jõulukomöödia Lavastaja:Ron Howard Osades:Jim Carrey, Jeffrey Tambor, Christine Baranski Grinch (Jim Carrey) on karvane roheline olevus, kes elab Kelleküla kohal kõrguva Mornimäe sisemuses asuvas koopas. Kui maailmas on midagi, mida Grinch ei salli, siis on selleks jõulud. Saatjaks vaid ta truu koer Max, on Grinch mõelnud välja plaani, kuidas lähenevad jõulud Kellekülas kõigile meelde jääks. Ta kavatseb varastada kogu linnast kõik kingitused, sest mis jõulud need ilma kingitusteta ikka on? Film kandideeris kolmele Oscarile, võites parima grimmi kategoorias.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Suurbritannia, USA 2016 põnevusmärul Lavastaja:Paul Greengrass Osades:Matt Damon, Julia Styles, Alicia Vikander, Vincent Cassel, Tommy Lee Jones ja teised Endine CIA töötaja Nicky Parson (Julia Stiles) aitas kunagi Bourne'i (Matt Damon), haihtus seejärel ja töötab nüüd keelekandja juures, kes kavatseb paljastada kõik CIA ülisalajased operatsioonid . Nicky häkib CIA andmebaasi ja laadib alla kogu info salajaste operatsioonide kohta, kaasa arvatud Treadstone'i missiooni kohta, millest Bourne osa võttis. CIA agent Heather Lee (Alicia Vikander) avastab häkkimise ja teavitab sellest CIA juhti Robert Deweyt (Tommy Lee Jones), kes on ülisalajaste operatsioonide võtmeisik.

programme.title: Ferdinand
programme.desc: USA 2017 animakomöödia Lavastaja:Carlos Saldanha Osades(hääled):Mathias-Einari Leedo, Marilyn Jurman, Rea Lest, Tiit Sukk, Indrek Ojari, Mart Toome jt. Ferdinand on hiigelsuur härg, kellel on veel suurem süda. Pärast seda, kui teda peetakse eksklikult ohtlikuks metslaseks, võetakse Ferdinand kinni ja viiakse kodust kaugele paika, kus treenitakse loomi härjavõitluse areenile. Ferdinand aga kavatseb jõuda iga hinna eest tagasi oma pere juurde ega taha mingist härjavõitlusest kuuldagi. Põgenemiseks paneb ta kokku meeskonna eriti kirjudest kujudest ning algab tormakas retk läbi päikeselise Hispaania.

programme.title: Kuidas taltsutada lohet
programme.desc: USA 2010 animafilm Lavastaja(d): Dean DeBlois Chris Sanders Osades (hääled): Mikk Jürjens, Raimo Pass, Tõnu Oja, Liisa Pulk, Kristo Viiding, Kait Kall, Johannes Veski ja Marilyn Jurman. Elasid kord kaugel maal karmid viikingid ja metsikud lohed, kes olid omavahel aastasadu sõda pidanud. Häbelik (ja sobiva nimega) Kokutis on teismeline viiking, kes ei kuulukski nagu oma perekonda, mis koosneb eranditult kangelaslikest lohetapjatest. Kokutise maailm pööratakse pea peale pärast seda, kui ta kohtab noorukest lohet, kes paneb poisi ümbritsevat maailma täiesti uue nurga alt vaatama. "Kuidas taltsutada lohet" on Cressida Cowelli populaarsel lasteraamatul põhinev vaimukas animaseiklus, mis pärit samast paigast, kust jõudsid maailma ekraanidele "Shrek", "Madagaskar" ja "Kung fu panda". Kestvus: 1 tundi 38 minutit

programme.title: Rio
programme.desc: USA 2011 animakomöödia Lavastaja: Carlos Saldanha Osades (hääled): Andero Ermel, Evelin Pang, Hannes Urbla, Mirtel Pohla, Tõnu Oja, Tiit Sukk, Janek Joost, Kait Kall, Karol Kuntsel, Taavi Teplenkov, Tarvo Krall, Elina Pähklimägi, Indrek Ojari, Tõnn Lamp, Anne Reemann, Juss Haasma jpt. Blu on haruldasest liigist sinine makao, kes elab ühes Minnesota vaikses raamatupoes. Ta arvab, et ta on viimane tema liigist makao, kuniks ta kuuleb, et Rio de Janeiros elab veel üks teine sinine makao, Jewel, kes pealekauba on veel emane. Selle tõttu viiakse ta Rio de Janeirosse, kus ta peab emasega paarituma, et tema liik ei sureks välja. Kuid seal olles röövitakse nii Blu kui ka Jewel röövlite poolt, kes tahavad nüüd nende eest lunaraha nõuda. Kuid õnneks imekombel saavad nad põgenema. Põgenemisest saati üritavad nüüd makaod üles leida Blu omaniku ning selle vältel peab Blu hakkama silmitsi seisma ka enda suurima hirmuga, lendamisega. "Rio" on animatsioon, mis sisaldab endas nii komöödiat kui ka seiklust. Film on loodud "Jääaja" triloogia loojate poolt.

programme.title: Sõjale kaotatud noorus
programme.desc: Vera Brittain on isepäine ja intelligentne noor naine, kes ei tee välja oma vanemate vastuseisust ega kodulinna eelarvamustest ning läheb õppima Oxfordi ülikooli. Elu on ilus, täis uusi tuuli, teadmisi ja armastust. Siis aga puhkeb sõda ning Vera vend Edward, tema kihlatu Roland ning nende sõbrad Victor ja Geoffrey saadetakse rindele.

programme.title: Kuidas taltsutada lohet
programme.desc: Karmil Berki saarel, kus viikingid ja lohed on põlvkondade vältel olnud lepitamatud vaenlased, eristub Kokutis (Mason Thames) kõigist teistest. Pealik Stoik Suure (Gerard Butler) leidlik, kuid tähelepanuta jäetud poeg sõbruneb kardetud tõugu lohega, kellel paneb nimeks Hambutu. Nende kahe vahel tekkiv side paljastab lohede tõelise olemuse, pannes sellega proovile viikingiühiskonna alustõed.

programme.title: Ahvide planeedi kuningriik
programme.desc: Mitu põlvkonda pärast Caesari valitsemisaega on ahvid kehtestanud end planeedi valitseva liigina, mille erinevad harud elavad harmoonias, samas, kui inimesed on sunnitud elama varjus, kõnevõimetute põgenikena. Kui ahvide seas haarab võimu end Proximus Caesariks nimetav türann, asub noor ahv Noa ohtuderikkale teekonnale, mis sunnib teda kahtlema kõiges, mida talle on mineviku kohta räägitud. Ning tegema valikuid, mil saab olema mõju nii ahvide kui inimeste tulevikule.

programme.title: Tavalised inglid
programme.desc: Film on inspireeritud uskumatust tõestisündinud loost juuksurist, kes koondab üksi terve kogukonna, et aidata leseks jäänud isal päästa oma raskelt haige väikese tütre elu.

programme.title: Missioon Titaan
programme.desc: Psühholoogilise põneviku "Missioon: Titan" peaosades astuvad üles Casey Affleck ("Manchester by the Sea", "Oppenheimer") ja Laurence Fishburne ("Matrixi" ja "John Wicki" filmid) ning film jutustab kolme astronaudi aastatepikkusest ja ehk ka probleemsest missioonist Saturni kuule Titanile. Kui tiim valmistub üliohtlikuks manöövriks, mis katapulteerib nad Titanile või süvakosmosesse, on ühel astronaudil aga üha raskem mõista, mis on päris.

programme.title: Fragrance & Emotions
programme.desc: Unique documentary that takes you to discover the secret of some of the most luxurious perfumes and emblematic fragrances in the world. Visit the famous city of Grasse to meet the creators, the beautiful flower fields and all the incredible emotional powers of the Perfume.

programme.title: In the Sea
programme.desc: About 71% of our planet's surface is covered by water, and about 97% of it is in the oceans. The sea also produces most of the oxygen we breathe. Thus, stimulating conservation and learning about also produces most of the oxygen we breathe. Thus, stimulating conservation and learning about the marine environment is fundamental to our very existence. This series follows scientists who work in five projects in the Petrobras Socio-environmental Program.

programme.title: Chanel No. 5, the Legendary Perfume
programme.desc: A revolutionary fragrance needs a visionary woman to create it! Gabrielle Chanel, the woman liberated others from corsage made the delightful perfume Chanel N°5 which remains the symbol of elegance around the world. This documentary will take you to Grasse to Paris & tell you the story of the legendary perfume.

programme.title: European Identities
programme.desc: What is European Identity? Is it cultural or political? Thibault Bourdon travels 8500 Km on his bicycle crossing multitude of dialects & landscapes, majestic mountains, stunning cliffs across the continent exploring this political & economic cohesion of 750 million people. In the end, the project of the European Union is a beautiful idea but, for Europeans.

programme.title: Fundamentalism: Is There A Way Back
programme.desc: A growing counter-terrorist movement is gaining worldwide momentum.After the attacks in New York, London, Madrid and Bali as well as the assassinations in Toulouse carried out by Mohamed Merah, the world wonders about how these Islamists came to the point they were able to commit such atrocities: to kill in cold blood and be willing to die a Martyr's death. How and why did these young men become radicals? Is it reversible?In a number of countries, deradicalization programs have sprung up. Have they been successful? In this documentary, the first ever of its kind, reporters will meet with some Islamists – former terrorists – who have left the path of terror and now dedicate their lives to persuading other terrorists to do the same.

programme.title: Yemen, Chaos in Silence
programme.desc: After three years of war, Yemen is facing its worst humanitarian crisis since the end of World War II. Yemen, chaos in silence"" is an unprecedented journey that tells the story of a conflict that is unfolding virtually without outside witnesses. From Aden in the south to Sanaa in the north, via Taez, the front line, this film explores a devastated country, eroded by political and religious divisions and ravaged by cholera.

programme.title: Yemen - Kids and the War
programme.desc: It is an exceptional documentary, filmed in a country no camera can penetrate - a world exclusive. In a context in which the biggest international networks are unable to present images of this forgotten war, the Yemeni director Khadija Al Salami has entrusted her camera to 3 children who become war correspondents for this documentary in Yemen. Ahmed is 11, Rima is 8 and Youssef is 9. It is them who will recount the daily life of theYemeni people under Saudi airstrikes. They meet other kids, collecting the testimonies of wounded children in hospital and those who lost their parents in the airstrikes. With the innocence of children, they also interview adults - a painter, a rapper, a model who has become "Miss War" on social media - and ask them to send a message to those who they believe are the only ones who can stop the war - the EuropeanUnion. Constructed like a story tale, with no images of violence, this deeply moving documentary shows the cruel reality of war through the eyes of children, and the incredible hope that they place in Europe to put an end to the conflict.

programme.title: Under the Lights: Pele
programme.desc: Pelé was a prodigy that played with "ginga". As a child he played insistently in the favelas as of Sao Paolo, he developed perfect balance, unique vision, and an unimaginable control of the ball that left everyone breathless. The King Pelé, as he was referred to by all Brazilians after winning the country's first World Cup in 1958, is the OLDEST LIVING LEGEND in all of sports. He is a global icon, and idol to so many, not only for the exceptional athlete was but for the human being he is. A true role model for so many around the world. Sabbatical's latest production is highlighted by remastered in game footage of Pelé's most legendary goals for Brazil throughout his indelible career.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Westward ho! We settle in Salt Lake City, where we learn about Bringham Young's settlement of the Utah territory and his monument at This is the Place Park. Then we dig in the dirt to find hundreds of perfectly preserved dinosaurs at the Utah Natural History museum. We'll take a look at some US aviation history at the Hill Air force Base museum, and see how life was like for the Utah pioneers at Frontier Homestead State Park.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Travel Thru History (or TTH for short) is a new educational/informational (E/I) series designed to spark interest and enthusiasm in viewers to learn about our country's rich and fascinating history by traveling to diverse locales across the US. While it is targeted to a teen audience, the entire family will enjoy watching TTH. Videotaped and edited in the style of other popular, educational programming like Modern Marvels, Travel Thru History is the latest television series co-developed by The Television Syndication Company and Red 5 Creative.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: A snapshot of Seasons, how they work together and keep the globe in balance. Droughts are explored in terms of how we can predict them, proof our lives from them and collect data because of them. Hurricanes are explained, their power revealed and the measures that are used to help us survive their impact. Thunderstorms have a few stages of development that roll out in a particular order.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: How are Rainbows formed and what's their science? We look at the largest Hail ever recorded and explain why it comes in so many shapes and sizes. Global Warming is a big issue and topic, and we give a nutshell insight to its meaning and impact on many levels. Forecasting is key and crucial to living with nature and its weather, as it involves precision technologies and expertise. Typhoon Halyan is an example of one of the most devastating storms in recent history and its story illustrates the power and destruction that Typhoons can cause.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Catch-and-release Chinook Salmon derby from Vancouver promoting Pacific Salmon Foundation!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial - a predator - that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia - a Tiger Quoll - smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world - something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it. In this series of 20 films, of 26 minutes each, the habitat will be a major showcase revealing our capacity to adapt ourselves at a time where we need to find solutions in order to address immense changes.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Join us as we cruise the backwaters of Kerala, one of the most beautiful and serene areas of India. We explore the cities of Cochin and Kozhikode. Attend a local theatre performance and learn about traditional drama styles. The drama continues as we witness a local festival and then take in a display of the ancient art of Kalaripayattu. Bill helps raise the Chinese fishing nets at dusk and tour a 1000 year old boat yard, where luxury vessels are still handcrafted.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Journeys in India is a ground-breaking travel series focusing on the Indian subcontinent. This first season highlights the history, culture, architecture, and wildlife of one of the most mysterious and exciting areas on earth. Perfect for the would-be or armchair traveler, this 13 part series is beautifully filmed with all original footage. Join host Bill Ball as he takes you on the adventures of a lifetime!

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This is one of the few national parks in Africa where the bush meets the ocean. The big game of Africa face off with the creatures of the deep. Our host goes a little rogue for supper and tries his hand at surf netting prawns after spending a day looking for the elusive elephants of Saadani.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: In all previous Journeys' shows, only glimpses of the cheetah were seen. Here at Kruger, we get up close to this shy cat before heading out of the park and visiting a special research and breeding center dedicated to cheetahs.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Follow breathtaking travel adventures of some well known athletes of extreme sports. Have a look at some stunning locations in Alaska, Mexico, Argentina, Japan, Tahiti, Africa, Costa Rica, Norway, Hawaii and whitewater kayaking, extreme big mountain skiing, windsurfing, kiteboarding, extreme snowboarding and big wave surfing that push the limits of possibility. The focus is on compelling personalities and great storytelling.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! - No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people - from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: China Uncovered
programme.desc: From the skyscrapers of Shanghai to the mountainous peaks of "The Last Shangri-La", explore the breathtaking landscape of this incredible country and connect with the people that infuse China's everyday life with flavor, passion and prosperity. Through the eyes of a cultural academic, a laborer, an architect, an urban planner, and a photographer, the grand evolution of a little fishing village is illustrated and documented to reveal one of the fastest growing megacities in the world. And while the physical landscape gracefully moves towards the future, beliefs, behaviors, and practices are put into test. The changes brought by the Thirty Year Miracle are indeed immense, and it has left no stone, no life, unturned.

programme.title: Hidden Traces
programme.desc: This documentary series uses cutting edge technology to shed new light on historical conflicts and the characters who lived through them with each episode dealing with a specific event or period in history. The viewer learns what daily life was really like for the common footsoldier during WWI as archeaologists bring their stories to life. An analysis of Napoleon's strategy and the impact of the weather reveal why he was defeated by Wellington at Waterloo. Traces of the remains of Hitler's destroyed retreat on the Obersalzberg uncover the extent of the vast structural complex where he spent time with his mistress, Eva Braun. And, many years after the conflict in Vietnam, secret tunnels and unexploded bombs can still be found.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Paris - Berlin: Shapes and Shades of History
programme.desc: Paris and Berlin have developed and grown facing each other over four centuries of tumultuous historical relationships and mutual admiration. The architecture and urbanism bear witness of this complex and rich confrontation.

programme.title: Hidden Traces
programme.desc: This documentary series uses cutting edge technology to shed new light on historical conflicts and the characters who lived through them with each episode dealing with a specific event or period in history. The viewer learns what daily life was really like for the common footsoldier during WWI as archeaologists bring their stories to life. An analysis of Napoleon's strategy and the impact of the weather reveal why he was defeated by Wellington at Waterloo. Traces of the remains of Hitler's destroyed retreat on the Obersalzberg uncover the extent of the vast structural complex where he spent time with his mistress, Eva Braun. And, many years after the conflict in Vietnam, secret tunnels and unexploded bombs can still be found.

programme.title: Город мастеров
programme.desc: Вольный средневековый город с величественным замком, живописной рыночной площадью и уютными домами покоряют войска злобного рыцаря де Маликорна. Гнусный тиран рассылает повсюду шпионов, вербует доносчиков и собирается жениться на первой красавице Веронике. Но свободолюбивый горбун Караколь, которому напророчено избавление от горба и свадьба с Вероникой, собирает униженных жителей на бой против завоевателей. Фильм-сказка по мотивам пьесы Тамары Габбе "Город мастеров, или Сказка о двух горбунах".

programme.title: Лавстори
programme.desc: Актёр-неудачник на очередных пробах вспоминает о своей первой любви. На следующий день он отправляется на работу - водителем элитного такси. Ему предстоит везти на лимузине капризную дамочку из Москвы в Сочи. Каково же будет его удивление, когда в этой особе он узнает Машу - ту самую первую любовь. Путешествие перестаёт быть скучным, ведь первая любовь - остаётся в сердце навсегда. и может быть им дан второй шанс, чтобы понять это...

programme.title: Пара на пару
programme.desc: Костя и Оля — преподаватели в вузе. На отдыхе в санатории Оля увлекается более респектабельным мужчиной — Сергеем. Костя, не найдя лучшего способа вернуть утраченное, решает сблизиться с его дочерью Соней — это единственный способ, чтобы снова оказаться рядом с Олей и попытаться с ней поговорить. Соня не слишком заинтересована в Косте, но идея позлить отца на ужине с его новой пассией кажется ей весьма соблазнительной: особенно после того, как тот выгнал её парня Макса за \"несерьёзность\". Так муж и жена оказываются под одной крышей в разных парах.

programme.title: Преступление и наказание
programme.desc: Экранизация одноименного романа Ф. Достоевского. Бедный студент Родион Раскольников идет на преступление, за которым неизбежно следуют муки совести: его душа, отягощенная грехом убийства, мечется между верой и безверием, надеждой и отчаянием. Расследование сыщика Порфирия Петровича в конечном итоге выводит следствие на Раскольникова, но еще до знакомства со следователем Родион встречает настоящую любовь. Она поможет ему прийти к покаянию.

programme.title: Конь Юлий и большие скачки
programme.desc: Дождались: говорящий конь Юлий влюбился! И на этот раз все серьезно - он просит руки, то есть копыта​ королевской кобылы по имени Звезда Востока у султана Рашида. Но сватать кобылу королевских кровей может только особа царских кровей.​ Юлий обращается к князю Киевскому за помощью, но получает отказ. Но наш жених не намерен отказываться от любви. Он похищает князя и насильно везет его к султану, на сватовство. И у богатырей​ тоже​ есть дело в восточной стороне. Все сойдутся на больших скачках, где победитель получит всё.

programme.title: Я остаюсь
programme.desc: 52-летний доктор Виктор Тырса, семьянин и человек практичный, работает в частной клинике и скептически относится к мнению, что после смерти жизнь не заканчивается. Однажды нетрезвый посетитель боулинга неудачно бросает шар, а Виктор получает травму головы и впадает в кому. Так врач-скептик оказывается в странном месте в компании с такими же, как он — людьми, уже не принадлежащими этому миру, но ещё не принятыми в мир иной.

programme.title: Три богатыря и Конь на троне
programme.desc: Князь и Конь Юлий после спора о будущем отечества случайно меняются телами. Происходит это не без помощи колдовства их старой знакомой Бабы-Яги. Болтливый Юлий отправляется во дворец, чтобы войти в историю, ведь он точно знает, как благоустроить Киев, чтобы в него поехали туристы... А Князь, в теле коня, остался пахать поле. Вернуть всё на свои места не так-то просто, но за дело берутся три богатыря. Кто же ещё сможет раскрыть такое коварство...

programme.title: Лев Яшин. Вратарь моей мечты
programme.desc: Молодой вратарь команды \"Динамо\" Лев Яшин заменил знаменитого Хомича и пропустил мяч в пустые ворота. С этого момента он понял, что с одним талантом далеко не продвинешься. Талантливому спортсмену предстоит много работать и даже его желание быть нападающим, будет играть на молниеносную реакцию вратаря, которого признают лучшим в мире. Он первым получит \"Золотой мяч\" из голкиперов и советских футболистов. Всю спортивную жизнь он будет играть за одну команду - \"Динамо\", а в составе сборной СССР станет чемпионом Олимпиады-1956 года.

programme.title: Подельники
programme.desc: Молодой биатлонист Петя вместе с женой Настей возвращается в родное село — работать физруком. Их встречают суровая природа и суровые люди, живущие по законам тайги. По этим законам убийство за оскорбление — право сильного, а сильнее шамана Вити Людоеда, бывшего зека, здесь никого нет. Петя становится свидетелем его кровавого преступления. Вызов убийце решается бросить только 10-летний Илья, сын жертвы. Петя не может оставить ученика наедине со страшной местью: Илья должен усиленно тренироваться, и тогда Петя поможет ему расквитаться с Людоедом.

programme.title: Бешенство
programme.desc: В тайге разгорается эпидемия бешенства среди диких животных. В это время отец привозит своего сына в охотничий домик, чтобы передержать его там во время ломки. Вместе они оказываются в смертельной западне.

programme.title: Hangman
programme.desc: Mystery movie. American mystery, produced in 2017. Retired homicide detective Ray Archer and his partner, ex FBI agent Will Ruiney, are assigned to track down a vicious serial killer, who is playing a twisted version of the children's game 'Hangman'.

programme.title: Land Of the Blind
programme.desc: A soldier recounts his relationship with a famous political prisoner attempting to overthrow their country's authoritarian government.

programme.title: Lost Treasure of Jesse James
programme.desc: A backwoods team of Missouri kids race to solve a 100 year old mystery and save their friends in this family friendly action adventure. Chased deep into ancient caves they must escape treasure hunters hot on their trail or be lost forever.

programme.title: The Lucky Dragon
programme.desc: A young, Chinese dragon punished by the gods to be a mere mortal is cast down to earth. He is forced to make his way in a strange land until the evil forces discover his true identity. Take part in a world full of imagination while following the journey of a mischievous dragon who has been transformed by magic into a little boy and exiled from his home to live among humans. When both good and evil forces learn that a dragon has arrived, they look for him as he is the only one who can find the magical sword—whose owner can rule the universe! Will he find the sword in time before it gets into the wrong hands? Will he ever become a dragon again?

programme.title: Prince and Me 2: The Royal Wedding
programme.desc: The Prince and Me 2: The Royal Wedding continues the story of 2003's fantasy romance The Prince and Me. In the earlier film, Paige (Julia Stiles) - a midwestern college co-ed - falls in love with Edvard (Luke Mably), sans realizing that he is actually the Prince of Denmark. In this sequel, Paige (now played by neophyte Kam Heskin) and Eddie must confront a centuries-old Danish edict declaring that if a Danish prince marries a commoner, he must abdicate his throne. C

programme.title: Nico the Unicorn
programme.desc: A 12-year-old disabled boy, whose father recently passed away, has his life changed when the pony he rescues gives birth to a unicorn. Can he save the unicorn from the people who want to exploit it?

programme.title: Saving Lincoln
programme.desc: Director Salvador Litvak and his writing partner, Nina Davidovich Litvak, based their screenplay on their extensive research into Lincoln's friendship with Lamon. ''Saving Lincoln'' charts their relationship from their initial meeting to Lincoln's Presidency. Lamon was a tall, boisterous Southerner who liked to drink whiskey, tell jokes and stories, play the banjo, and wrestle. Despite some pronounced differences between the two men, they shared a fondness for telling jokes and stories, and both felt slavery should be eliminated. Lamon often served as Lincoln's private confidant.

programme.title: See You in September
programme.desc: See You in September is an original romantic comedy set in current day Manhattan. The film centers around Lindsay, a beautiful woman who seemingly has it all, but is deeply afraid of commitment. When she finds out that her therapist takes a vacation for the entire month of August she feels shocked and abandoned. Instead of taking this news lying down, Lindsay enlists the help of her acerbic best friend Monica to come up with a solution. With the assistance of "Craig's List", Lindsay puts together a group therapy session for all Manhattanites who are in need of therapy, but more importantly angry at their therapists for abandoning them.

programme.title: Rat Race
programme.desc: Donald P. Sinclair has placed six separate gold coins in different slot machines in his casino. The lucky six who find these coins discover an opportunity of a lifetime. The chance to own $2 million. Locked up in a locker in New Mexico, these six contestants must now race each other, to be the first to the cash. There are no rules in place and everything that could possibly happen, does. Whilst, behind the scenes, Sinclair's associates are placing their bets.

programme.title: Caesar
programme.desc: Epic look at Julius Caesar, Rome's last dictator, whose death also signaled the end of the Roman Republic. Chronicles his campaigns in Gaul and Egypt, his rivalry with General Pompey, and his eventual assassination at the hands of Brutus and Cassius.

programme.title: Irish Jam
programme.desc: A South Central L.A. con artist with rap skills tries to keep bill collectors and his lover, with marriage in mind, at bay by entering a poetry contest staged by a small Irish town. Can his rhyming skills help the town and win him the prize money?

programme.title: Unexpected
programme.desc: Bob and Amy are at a crossroads: she wants to adopt a child, he doesn't. Will renovating their house and rescuing animals solve their problems? Will their new handyman and his son's pregnant girlfriend be the miracle they're looking for?...

programme.title: Castle Falls
programme.desc: Action movie. After years of neglect, a building-landmark will be demolished with dynamite. What a few people know is that inside it hides the cash a gang leader stole from his rivals. Will the interested parties reach the treasure in time?

programme.title: Looks That Kill
programme.desc: Max Richards, a teenage boy born with a medical condition of being lethally attractive, who is changed forever when he meets Alex, a girl with her own bizarre ailment, who aids him on his quest of self-discovery... without accidentally killing someone.

programme.title: The Flock
programme.desc: This film is about a hyper-vigilant employee of the department of public safety who, while training his young female replacement, has to track down a missing girl who he is convinced is connected to a paroled sex offender he is investigating.

programme.title: Kallis John
programme.desc: USA 2010 romantiline draama Lavastaja: Lasse Hallström Osades: Channing Tatum, Amanda Seyfried, Richard Jenkins, Henry Thomas Film räägib kahest noorest, Johnist ja Savannah'st, kes armusid esimesest silmapilgust. Nende vahel tekib suur armastus. Kuid nagu alati, tekib ka selles armastuses takistusi. Nimelt John on sõdur ning peale aastast eemalolekut kodulinnast, värvatakse teda taas edasi Saksamaale, mis tähendaks Savannah'st eemalolekut väga kauaks ajaks. Nii leiabki John end kahe tule vahelt, kas minna või jääda?

programme.title: Piinlik hetk
programme.desc: Komöödia. Jason (Zac Efron) jäeti just maha, Mikey (Michael B. Jordan) naine palus lahutust ja Daniel (Miles Teller) on jätkuvalt poissmees. Kolm parimat sõpra otsustavad koos vallaliseks ja vallatuteks jääda. Kuid siis kohtab Jason Elliet, kes võib see õige olla ja Daniel mõistab, et Chelsea on talle ideaalne kaaslane ning Mikey on alati oma naisega koos olla soovinud. Noormeestel on suuri raskusi oma vallalise eluga ja olukord muutub piinlikuks… Film ei sobi alaealistele.

programme.title: Maggie Moore(s)
programme.desc: Filmi "Maggie Moore (x2)" tegevus leiab aset tolmuses kõrbelinnas, kus ei juhtu eal midagi, kuni järsku peab politseiülem lahendama kaks samaaegset samanimelise naise mõrva.

programme.title: Salaagent
programme.desc: Tšehhi-Šveits-Suurbritannia- USA-Prantsusmaa 2016 märul. Alice Racine (Rapace), raske lapsepõlvega CIA ülekuulaja, elab nüüd Londonis ja töötab seal salaagendina. Kui terrorist Alice'ilt üliolulist infot välja petab, satub Alice tahtmatult sündmuste keerisesse, mille tulemuseks on laastav biorünnak Londonile. Järgneb tappev kassi-hiire mäng, mille käigus elu eest võitlev Alice ei tea, keda ta usaldada võib. Lavastaja: Michael Apted Osades: Noomi Rapace, Orlando Bloom, Toni Collette, Michael Douglas, John Malkovich

programme.title: Fabelmanid
programme.desc: Seitsmele Oscarile kandideerinud suurfilm. Steven Spielbergi seni kõige isiklikum film põhineb režissööri lapsepõlve kirel filmitegemise vastu ja perekonna dünaamikal, mis imbus ka tema töösse.

programme.title: Colette
programme.desc: Tavatu maatüdruk Sidonie-Gabrielle Colette (Keira Knightley) on abielus endast 14 aastat vanema karismaatilise enesearmastajast õpetlasega, keda teatakse vaid nime all Willy (Dominic West). Mees tutvustab Colette'ile Pariisi hedonistlikku ja viljakat kunstimaailma, mis innustab naist oma loovust proovile panema. Naise annet kärmelt ära kasutav Willy annab Colette'ile loa ise romaane kirjutada, kuid avaldada vaid mehe nime all. "Claudine'i" raamatusarja ennenägematu edu teeb Willyst kuulsa kirjaniku ning Colette'ist ja Willlyst esimese tänapäevase kuulsustepaari. Kuid vaatamata kõigi imetlusele hakkab tunnustamata töö Colette'i hinge närima. Willy truudusetus ja Colette'i kasvav huvi naiste vastu, eriti tema suhe soorolle eirava Missyga, viivad abielu lagunemiseni. Emotsionaalses ja kunstilises plaanis ei suuda naine aga Willyst vabaneda. Võlgade katteks ja abikaasa saboteerimiseks võtab hätta sattunud Willy kasutusele äärmuslikud meetmed, kuid Colette'il endalgi on nii mõndagi varuks.

programme.title: Mässaja rukkis
programme.desc: Eluloofilm ühest 20. sajandi olulisimast kirjanikust J. D. Salingerist, mis keskendub ennekõike tema kõige kuulsama romaani "Kuristik rukkis" sünniloole ja näitab, kui vaevaline võib olla ühe meistriteose loomise protsess. Loo peategelasteks on Salinger (Nicholas Hoult, "Mad Max: Raevu tee") ja teda mõjutanud inimesed, eriti ta juhendaja Whit Burnett (Kevin Spacey, "Kaardimaja"). Noort kirjanikku piinavad sõjamälestused ja isikliku elu probleemid, kuid sellest hoolimata saavutab ta kirjandusmaastikul edu ja saab maailmakuulsaks.

programme.title: Fabelmanid
programme.desc: Seitsmele Oscarile kandideerinud suurfilm. Steven Spielbergi seni kõige isiklikum film põhineb režissööri lapsepõlve kirel filmitegemise vastu ja perekonna dünaamikal, mis imbus ka tema töösse.

programme.title: Adaline'i aeg
programme.desc: Romantiline fantaasiadraama. Adaline Bowman (Blake Lively, "Kõmutüdruk") sünnib 20. sajandi alguses. Noore naisena juhtub temaga aga õnnetus, mille tagajärjel juhtub omalaadne ime - ta ei vanane tulevikus päevagi. Adaline elab edaspidi üksilduses, ennast varjates ja lähedasi suhteid vältides, et tema saladus ilmsiks ei tuleks. Kuid ühel päeva ootab teda ees saatuslik kohtumine sarmika Ellisega (Michiel Huisman, "Metsik"), mis pöörab naise senise rahuliku elu täielikult pea peale…

programme.title: Minu kuningas
programme.desc: Tony (Emmanuelle Bercot) on noor naine, kes kohtab ööklubis Georgiot (Vincent Cassel). Siit saab alguse armastuslugu, kuhu jagub külluses tundeid ja kirge. Kümme aastat hiljem, kui Tony suusakuurordis põlvevigastusega voodis lamab, vaeb ta taas olnut ja suhet Georgioga, mis nagu Ameerika mäed, oli hoogsate tõusude ning langustega, sekka ka sisemiste traumadega. Selle suhtedraama teevad köitvaks eelkõige väärt näitlejatööd, režissöör on peaosalistele andnud sedapuhku ka improviseerimisvabadust. Rõhutatult realistlikus laadis esitatud lugu avab mõlema poole vaatepunktid. Tundlik ja kirglik naine ning enesekindel, šarmantne ja vaimukas mees oleks kui ideaalne paar, ent see, mis nende suhetes põnevust ning pinget loob, osutub ka takistavaks. Film kandideeris Cannes'is Kuldsele Palmioksale, Emmanuelle Bercot pärjati samas parima naisnäitleja tiitliga. Kaheksa Prantsuse filmiauhinna Cesar nominatsiooni.

programme.title: Hiina pusle
programme.desc: Prantsuse draamakomöödia inimsuhetest, mille peaosalisi kehastavad esmaklassilised Prantsuse staarid Romain Duris ("Löök, mille mu süda vahele jättis") ja Audrey Tatou ("Amelie"). Xavier on just saanud 40-aastaseks. Tema kaasa Wendy lahutab mehest ja otsustab nende kahe lapsega New Yorki kolida. Xavier mõistab, et ei suuda ega taha ilma nendeta elada. Ta otsustab samuti Suurde Õuna suunduda, kuid seal ootavad teda ees ootamatud elu keerdkäigud…

programme.title: Adaline'i aeg
programme.desc: Romantiline fantaasiadraama. Adaline Bowman (Blake Lively, "Kõmutüdruk") sünnib 20. sajandi alguses. programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: Школа
programme.desc: Успешная бизнес-леди Катя узнает, что её дочь пыталась покончить жизнь самоубийством. Как оказалось, не впервые. Чтобы быть ближе к дочери и понять, чем на самом деле занимаются дети в школе, она начинает работать учительницей экономики. Молодая мама понятия не имела, какие секреты скрываются за стенами обычной школы. Тогда же в учебное заведение приходит новый преподаватель английского - бывший адвокат и сын директора Алекс. У него есть невеста, которая живет в США, но вдруг между ним и Екатериной промелькнула искра. Впрочем, скелеты прошлого всё ещё дают о себе знать и не отпускают героев...

programme.title: Женский доктор
programme.desc: Действие разворачивается в новой современной клинике, которую основал профессор Юрий Климов. Бывшему тестю доктора Романа Широкова остался лишь год до выхода на пенсию, и за это время он должен найти достойного преемника. Но это не главная причина, по которой профессор вновь приглашает Романа работать вместе. Роман Широков – единственный, кто может довести до конца инновационную научную разработку, от которой зависит судьба дочери профессора - Нины. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

Бывшему тестю доктора Романа Широкова остался лишь год до выхода на пенсию, и за это время он должен найти достойного преемника. Но это не главная причина, по которой профессор вновь приглашает Романа работать вместе. Роман Широков – единственный, кто может довести до конца инновационную научную разработку, от которой зависит судьба дочери профессора - Нины. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

programme.title: Любовь с ароматом кофе
programme.desc: Красавица Аля – мать-одиночка, работает баристой и воспитывает 5-ти летнего сына. Бывший парень бросил ее одну с ребенком. Девушка долго никого не подпускала к себе, пока не встретила мажора Гошу. И впервые за долгое время подумала, что он ― тот мужчина, с которым можно шагать по жизни легко и просто. Но Гоша бросает девушку. В это время Аля встречает друга Гоши Костю, который предлагает ей сделку: сыграть роль его несносной, бесцеремонной невесты, чтобы семья перестала думать о женитьбе Кости. Но все идет не по плану….

programme.title: Дневники Темного
programme.desc: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.desc: Viewers follow the transformation of homes, renovation projects, and community initiatives in an engaging and informative way. Each episode highlights practical solutions, creative design ideas, and real-life stories, offering inspiration for personal living spaces. The program combines entertainment with useful insights, helping audiences discover innovative ways to enhance comfort, style, and functionality at home.

programme.title: River Hunters
programme.desc: In River Hunters, Rick Edwards and river-searching expert Beau Ouimette visit some of the most historically significant sites across Britain: covering iconic events and battles including Roman Briton, the Wars of the Roses, the Reformation and the English Civil War. Their searches of these unexplored rivers and waterways unearth treasures from the past which reveal how our various ancestors used to live. As the artefacts surface from under layers of silt and rocks, the duo will meet with local archaeologists and historians to unearth the stories and people behind the finds. Spanning each river's layered past, the new series will offer a fresh perspective and even redefine our history as we know it. Using state-of-the-art technology, archive maps and contemporaneous accounts from the period, Beau and Rick perform the first underwater archeological digs in some of the most exciting and iconic historical sites in Britain, often in dangerous and fast-flowing water.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: Despite all of our modern technology and sophistication, there is much that we still don't know about what lies beneath our feet, deep underground. What is at the center of the Earth? Is there really a solid core of heavy metals, or could it be a hollow environment, as many researchers claim? And just how much of mankind's history took place underground? Recent discoveries of ancient underground structures such as the city of Derinkuyu and the Malta Hypogeum suggest that there may be more structures down there, waiting to be re-discovered. If much of our past was subterranean, could our future be as well?

programme.title: Cities of the Underworld
programme.desc: In major cities around the world today, skyscrapers loom overhead, taxis honk their horns and street vendors peddle their wares. But below lies city upon city - each with its fascinating and unknown history. This series will explore these layers, which are often hundreds of feet deep, and examine a city's ancient cisterns, dank dungeons, eerie tombs, clandestine hideouts, and even underground shipwrecks that have been lost for hundreds and hundreds of years. What are the underground layers of the most populated cities on earth? And how did (and do) engineers build layer upon layer up to today's city streets? This series will reveal the technological marvels that allowed the construction of one city upon another - literally.

programme.title: Beyond Oak Island
programme.desc: From the producers of "The Curse of Oak Island" and "The UnXplained" comes an exciting new documentary series, "Beyond Oak Island." Hosted by real-life treasure hunters Rick and Marty Lagina, this eight episode series chronicles the greatest treasure hunts of the past, present and (perhaps) future. "Beyond Oak Island" offers a combination of great story telling, compelling interviews with treasure-hunters, historians and experts, as well as on-location treasure hunts in progress, sometimes with the Laginas themselves. From pirates such as Blackbeard and outlaws like Jesse James, to Aztec gold, priceless historical artifacts from American history and sunken treasure ships, "Beyond Oak Island" digs deep into the many treasure quests across the globe, revealing amazing new details and clues from past searches - and in some cases, advancing the hunt.

programme.title: UFO Hunters
programme.desc: The team's access to UFO evidence is unparalleled and their expertise allows them to quickly identify bogus claims of UFOs. Together, they use eyewitness accounts, scientific experimentation, documents recently released through the Freedom of Information Act and footage that has never been seen before on television to piece together compelling — and at times chilling — evidence of UFO phenomena. Join UFO Hunters Bill Birnes, Pat Uskert, Dr. Ted Acworth, and Jeff Tomlinson as they separate fact from fallacy.

programme.title: Bible Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: Documentary series in which viewers have a chance to explore the mysteries and reveal secrets and hidden facts of the world's most famous and oldest book - the Bible. For thousands of years, The Holy Bible has been the foundation on which Judaism and Christianity are built, but there are still many secrets and things which can be interpreted differently. Featuring stunning on-location photography, interesting reenactments and interviews with scientists, archaeologists and religious leaders, this series will take us on remarkable journey back in time to see what the Old Testament and the New Testament are hiding from us - from Dead Sea Scrolls, examinations of the traditional belief that Moses wrote the Torah, to whether Adam and Eve were created together or one before the other, who authored the New Testament and many other mysteries.

programme.title: Ross Kemp: Deep Sea Treasure Hunter
programme.desc: In a brand-new Sky HISTORY show, Ross Kemp dives on a series of incredible shipwrecks around the British coastline to reveal some of the nation's murkiest and best-kept secrets. From the remains of a slave ship discovered off Plymouth, to the Kaiser's sunken Imperial Fleet in Scapa Flow and an experimental submarine aircraft carrier, which sank with all passengers and crew on deck during its sea trials, Ross uncovers Britain's hidden maritime past.

programme.title: The Curse of Civil War Gold
programme.desc: Treasure hunters Rick and Marty Lagina, the stars of History's "The Curse of Oak Island," learn of a new mystery that may even rival Oak Island's. Michigan native Kevin Dykstra is obsessed with a deathbed confession made by a lighthouse keeper in the 1890s about a national treasure dating back to the Civil War. The story goes that Union soldiers tracked down Confederate president Jefferson Davis in 1865 and confiscated his gold. The stolen loot was smuggled north some years later but ended up in Lake Michigan, where Dykstra believes it still remains. His quest to prove it ultimately takes him and his team to the bottom of Lake Michigan.

programme.title: Gold Hunters: Legend of the Superstition Mountains
programme.desc: Legend tells of the Lost Dutchman's gold mine hidden somewhere within the 160,000 acres of brutal Arizona desert known as the "Superstition Mountains." The promise of a $200 million mother lode has lured thousands of treasure hunters and continues to claim the lives of those eager to decipher the legend's clues and riddles. Hunting for the Lost Dutchman is typically a one-man journey, but lifelong Dutch Hunter Wayne Tuttle is breaking with tradition and partnering with a team of experts to follow a newly revealed clue that could finally solve the 500-year-old mystery of America's most famous and deadliest buried treasure. With cursed mountains said to drive men mad and a hidden fortune of gold worth killing for, the treasure hunter's greatest danger may be the man at his side. Trust at your own peril if you dare to tread into HISTORY's Legend of the Superstition Mountains.

programme.title: Battles BC
programme.desc: Step back in time and revisit some of the most brutal battles that took place before Christ. Recreated with stunning technology, we reveal these violent conflicts like never before, examining the soldiers, strategies and weapons deployed by the powerful legions. From Hannibal's clashes with Rome to Alexander the Great's pursuits throughout India, these conflicts have had a resounding impact on our history and with these reconstructions you will see the ferocious aspects of war in antiquity.

programme.title: Азия 360
programme.desc: Что вы знаете о Центральной Азии? То, что эти страны когда-то входили в состав СССР, и то, что люди сейчас там живут бедно, живут в кишлаках и ездят на ослах, мечтают переехать в Россию и работать там, пьют только зеленый чай и едят плов и мясо, притесняют людей других национальностей? Мы решили развеять самые распространенные мифы о Центральной Азии, а также рассказать о забытых традициях и блюдах, которые шокируют иностранцев, а иногда даже самих местных.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека
programme.desc: Закоренелый холостяк Чарли, постоянно опасающийся за свою свободу, и его брат Алан, недавно разошедшийся с женой, живут под одной крышей. Чарли только и делает, что заводит любовные интрижки, а Алан всеми силами пытается от него не отстать. В свободное от амурных приключений время братья воспитывают десятилетнего сынишку Алана Джейка.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека

programme.title: Время надежды
programme.desc: Надежда мечтает о большой любви и светлом будущем. По ней с детства сохнет скоромный отличник Егор. Однако в тот момент, когда он набрался решимости сделать девушке предложение, она влюбляется в его друга, самоуверенного ловеласа Ивана. Вскоре Надя выходит за него замуж и молодые переезжают в квартиру к свекрови. Мать Ивана не одобряет его выбор, но готова терпеть невестку ради новорожденного внука Ванечки. Счастливая жизнь девушки рушится в одночасье, когда муж неожиданно погибает, а сын исчезает. И теперь его поиски становятся для Надежды единственным смыслом жизни.

programme.title: Сводные судьбы
programme.desc: Никто не застрахован от ошибок молодости. Эта участь не миновала и немолодого преуспевающего бизнесмена Роберта Шатова. Узнав о своей смертельной болезни, он решает устроить судьбу своих взрослых дочерей, которые не подозревают о его существовании. Он покупает им квартиры на одной лестничной клетке и подстраивает обстоятельства, при которых они эти квартиры получают: одна - в наследство, другая - от работы, третья - в долгосрочную аренду на выгодных условиях, под офис. Но это только начало: в его планах - полный пакет счастья для каждой из дочек. Но, конечно, дочери воспринимают неожиданное появление папы неоднозначно...

programme.title: Сводные судьбы

programme.title: Госпожа Фазилет и ее дочери
programme.desc: Госпожа Фазилет после того, как потеряла мужа, одна воспитывает двух дочек. Вся жизнь Фазилет прошла в сожалениях, поэтому теперь ее вкладом в будущее стала младшая дочь Эдже. Но самым большим препятствием на пути матери является старшая дочь Хазан, которая несмотря на свою изысканную красоту ведет себя по-мальчишески и не ладит с матерью. Семья Эймен богата, могущественна, у них особняк на берегу Босфора, и однажды их пути пересекаются с Фазилет и ее дочерьми. Богатство Эймен даже превосходит мечты Фазилет. После знакомства с ними изменится не только жизнь Эдже, но и Хазан, которая влюбится в Синана Эймена, избалованного сына семьи.

programme.title: Клерк
programme.desc: Женя Скороходов - обычный клерк. Он заканчивает Финансовую академию, работает операционистом в банке. Его серую жизнь скрашивает безнадежная влюбленность в красавицу-коллегу Вику. Как-то в обеденный перерыв Женя развлекает Вику и коллег тем, что придумывает план идеального ограбления их банка. На следующий день происходит ограбление. Главный подозреваемый - Женя. С риском для жизни он начинает собственное расследование, в ходе которого, понимает, что Вика совсем не та, за кого себя выдает.

programme.desc: Ежедневная информационная программа Настоящего времени.

programme.title: Лицом к событию
programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Ольга
programme.desc: Всё семейство Терентьевых на ушах - нужно вытаскивать Тимофея из беды. До загулявшей Ольги никто не может дозвониться, поэтому пытаются справиться своими силами. Юрген и его друзья алкоголики спекулируют духовными скрепами потерпевшего, ведь православие учит прощать. Аня и Лев отправляются просить о помощи Гришу, но бабушка Гриши дает понять, что отпустит внука к Терентьевым только через свой труп. Лена узнает, что Митяй в загуле после того, как она его \"отбрила\". Лена пытается остановить Митяя, чтобы тот не наделал глупостей…

programme.title: Ольга
programme.desc: Главная героиня воспитывает двух детей от разных браков, заботится об отце-алкоголике и пытается наладить личную жизнь. Старшая дочь Анька учится в ПТУ, думает, что она единственный адекватный член семьи и в её жизни все будет по-другому, младший сын Тимофей, чей отец вернулся к первой семье в Азербайджан, считает, что он уже мужчина, хотя ему всего лишь 11 лет, отец Ольги, бывший футболист, крепко выпивает и постоянно врет, а сестра Ленка пытается жить за счет мужчин, в основном — женатых. Вечно спасая родственников от неприятностей, Ольга живет чужой жизнью и редко думает о себе — до тех пор, пока в нее не влюбляется молодой и положительный водитель газели "Ритуал" Гриша.

programme.title: Голое влечение
programme.desc: Скандальный цикл передач, в которых люди находят потенциальных спутников жизни, обнаженные тела которых им показывают. Затем они должны будут сами раздеться и сделать выбор.

programme.title: Анатомия убийства
programme.desc: Евгения и Сергей расстались, но она осталась работать патологоанатомом в местной полиции по приглашению следователя Перфильева. Сергей Карский получил возможность наслаждаться славой. После публикации его романа, который он написал не без участия Евгении, но что-то в их отношениях сломалось. Его друг, встретившись с Женей по работе, был крайне удивлён таким течением событий. Прекрасный специалист в своём деле Евгения продолжает раскрывать запутанные преступления, и Карский всегда готов оказаться рядом с ней во время поисков разгадок. Перфильев внимательнейшим образом относится ко всем предположениям талантливой коллеги...

programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: Hosted by Erin Burnett, an expert in political science and economics, OutFront is an hour-long news programme examining the latest stories from the US and further afield. Broadcast live from either the New York studio or live on location from the site of a breaking story, the show features insightful opinions from informed guests. With expert analysis from CNN's correspondents and analysis from the show's panel, Erin Burnett OutFront dissects the stories of the day, leaving no stone unturned. Burnett, a former financial analyst for Goldman Sachs, uses her forthright approach to engage interviewees in honest discussion.

programme.title: Anderson Cooper 360
programme.desc: Anderson Cooper delves into the day's news, looking beyond the broadcast to give his take, prompting us to re-think what we hear in the headlines. Cooper has covered major, international stories like the aftermath of Hurricane Katrina on the Gulf Coast, the catastrophic BP oil spill and the 2010 earthquake in Haiti, which saw the whole world fall silent. The show has won an absolute plethora of awards over the years, including GLAAD Media and Emmy awards.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Gumball is walking in the same direction as Hot Dog Guy and with each step it becomes increasingly awkward. programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Elmore residents are going missing and the cause of these disappearances may be closer to home than Gumball and Darwin think. programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin agree to do all of Tobias's chores in exchange for good points! programme.title: Goat Girl
programme.desc: Gigi, raised by mountain goats, attends boarding school at 13. Having had minimal human contact, this marks her first real exposure to society, prompting overseers Nanny and Billy to push her to spread her wings among people versus goats.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball

Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: Lana Longbeard

At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: Xplore Philippines
programme.desc: Join Indian movie star Elisha Kriis as she travels the archipelagic Philippines, uncovering the world of paradise this picturesque country has to offer. Compromising 7,641 islands, the Philippines boasts some of our planet's most idyllic beaches and blissful blue waters that draw in millions of tourists every year. With a population of over 104 million people, presenter Elisha Kriis reveals the history behind this former Spanish colony and what makes it uniquely different to its Southeast Asian neighbours. From the bustling Manilla to the calming Bohol, this stunning documentary series explores never-before-seen areas.

With a population of over 104 million people, presenter Elisha Kriis reveals the history behind this former Spanish colony and what makes it uniquely different to its Southeast Asian neighbours. From the bustling Manilla to the calming Bohol, this stunning documentary series explores never-before-seen areas.

programme.title: Burn Appetite

programme.title: Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Great World Hotels takes you on a journey to the some of the world's most luxurious hotels and resorts. We visit everything from your own personal lagoon island huts, the size of mansions, to the largest, most decadent penthouse in New York City. Live life like the stars as we explore every corner of the world from the comfort of your sofa. Season one alone takes us from Dubai to Mauritius to the Maldives. Whether you're an avid traveller or have never left the country, this journey is suitable for everyone. This is your journey. This is our journey.

programme.desc: Toomas ja tema naine Stella elavad koos oma kahe teismelise lapsega pealtnäha unistuste elu. Keegi ei või arvatagi, et pereisal on minevikust kahe miljoni suurune käendusvõlg ja et seda peret hoitakse üleval ainult kuritegevusega. Kui aga Toomasele tuleb pakkumine osaleda suures raharöövis, ei aima veel keegi, kui halvasti asjad minema hakkavad. Osades Margus Prangel, Helena Merzin, Mirjam Aimla ja Siim Sups. Režissöör Raoul Suvi, stsenarist Mikko Pölla.

programme.title: Kälimehed
programme.desc: Telelavastuse tegevus toimub ühe vaikse Eesti linnakese vaiksel kõrvaltänaval. Vaikelu saab aga rikutud, kui Urmase ja Riina kõrvalmajja kolib Riina õde Rebekka koos oma uue mehe Raivoga. Saatuse tahtel naabriteks ja kälimeesteks saanud Urmas ja Raivo on inimestena erinevad ning nende õdedest elukaaslased omavahel nagistanud lapsest saadik. Lavastuses näeme, kuidas üleaedsed peavad lahendama igale eestlasele nii tuttavaid probleeme naabrite läbikäimises ning mismoodi aitavad sellele kaasa õdede ellu sekkuv ema ning Raivo hämaravõitu äripartner Viks. Mängivad Peeter Oja, Sepo Seeman, Merle Palmiste, Hilje Murel, Ene Järvis, Andrus Vaarik, Jan Uuspõld, Ivo Eensalu jpt.

programme.title: Beverly Hills, 90210
programme.desc: Donna külastab kevadvaheajal Rayd. David läheb oma emale külla. Ray on Davidi peale armukade. Dylan otsib ideid Charlie stsenaariumi jaoks. Valerie teeb endale tätoveeringu.

programme.title: Skandaal
programme.desc: Endine USA Presidendi meediasuhete konsultant Olivia Pope on nüüd kriisijuht, kes suudab lahendada kõik probleemid nii, et keegi ei teagi, et sellised probleemid olemas olid. Kuid ükskõik kui hoolas sa oled oma töös, võid samal ajal enda eraelus väga palju kahju teha. Igal nädalal seisavad Olivia ja ta meeskond silmitsi paljude probleemidega, mis vajavad lahendamist. Ning kui nad suudavad päästa teiste inimeste elusid, ei tähenda see seda, et nad suudavad parandada ka enda omi.

programme.title: Papad Mammad
programme.desc: Neil vanavanematel pole aega sukka kududa ega rahvatantsutammuda, sest elu on selleks liiga pöörane! Armastatud sarja"Papad ja mammad" kolmandas hooajas ootavad Ullat ja Jürit ningVaiket ja Vollit ees uued, värvikad seiklused majutusäris, kus neiltuleb tegeleda eriskummaliste klientidega, kes tekitavad paksupahandust. Pidevas kaoses on tülid kiired tekkima ja vahest eipiisa enam sõnadest ja käiku tuleb lasta sõna otseses mõttesrusikad. Kui varasemalt olid Ulla ja Jüri suhted pingelised, siisseekord kisuvad Vaike ja Volli suhted järk järgult kiiva. Kõigeselle sasipuntra keskel on suvevaheaega veetmas Lenna.

Sarjas lõi kaasa Eesti näitlejate absoluutne paremik: Aarne Üksküla, Lembit Ulfsak, Guido Kangur, Ülle Kaljuste, Ita Ever, Ivo Uukkivi, Rita Rätsepp, Mait Malmsten, Kärt Kross, Angelina Semjonova, Triinu Meriste, Mari Lill, Andrus Vaarik, Hans Kaldoja, Dan Põldroos, Eduard Toman, Juhan Ulfsak, Merle Palmiste, Ines Aru, Helene Vannari jpt. programme.title: 11 000 aastat hiljem
programme.desc: Eesti parlament sai endale väärika parlamendihoone 1920. aastate algul, mis oli omal ajal moodne, ajastutäpne, suursugune ja õiges kohas. Ka täna rõhutab see maja, kui tähtis on enesest lugu pidada, hoides meeles rahva poolt antud mandaati. Taasiseseisvunud Eesti parlamendil oli raske alustada, ent sajad seadused nõudsid ja ootasid tegemist. See ajajärk on möödas. Mis on tänase parlamendi ülesanne olukorras, kus pettunud inimeste koor skandeerib ümber maja? Kas ka täna esindab parlament meid kõiki - kogu rahvast? Kas parlament peaks olema kasvõi mõnes asjas ühtne, mängima sama teost ja alluma ühele dirigendile? Mis on õigupoolest teos, mida mängitakse ja mida peab tegema dirigent? Saate autor Indrek Treufeldt, režissöör Tarvo Mölder, toimetaja Tiina Kaalep.

programme.title: Mõrvaennetajad
programme.desc: Avahooajal USAs laineid löönud põnevussari salapärasest miljardärist, kes värbab endale appi endise CIA agendi, et ühiselt ennetada New Yorki ähvardavaid ränki kuritegusid. Pururikas geenius Finch ("Teadmata kadunud" staar Michael Emerson) on välja töötanud arvutiprogrammi, mis suudab tuvastada potentsiaalse mõrvari või tema ohvri veel enne selle kuriteo reaalset toimumist. Endine eriagent Reese (Jim Caviezel), kes pärast isiklikku tragöödiat elab New Yorkis kodutuna, on nõus Fichiga kampa lööma ja aitab Finchil huvipakkuva isiku üles leida. Reese'i ülesandeks jääb ka tulevase tapja kahjutuks tegemine. Loomulikult peab tandem tegutsema ülima saladuskatte all, sest nende info ja tegevuse paljastamise tagajärjed oleksid katastroofilised.

programme.desc: Tundmatu snaiper tulistab linnapeakandidaati ja Chicago politsei tahab tulistaja tabada enne, kui ta järgmise sihtmärgi maha võtab.

programme.title: Surmarelv
programme.desc: Legendaarsetel "Surmarelva" filmidel põhinev veriväske action-komöödiasari toob taas kokku kinoajaloo vingeima detektiivide paari! Oma naist leinav endine eriüksuslane Martin Riggs (Clayne Crawford) ja pärast infarkti tööle naasev Roger Murtaugh (Damon Wayans) moodustavad üdini vastandliku, aga ometi ideaalselt toimiva tandemi. Nende koostöö algus on okkaline, sest ohjeldamatu Riggsi pea-ees-tulle-sööstmise suhtumine põrkub vaoshoitud Murtaugh arusaamadega. Esimese ühise juhtumi lõppedes mõistavad aga mõlemad, et on lisaks uuele paarimehele leidnud endale ka parima sõbra.

programme.title: Monk
programme.desc: Adrian Monk on üks San Francisco politseijaoskonna parimaid töötajaid, kuid pärast abikaasa traagilist surma on kõik muutunud: andekast detektiivist sai üleöö ettearvamatu ja impulsiivne inimene, kellel on ebanormaalsed hirmud ja kes ärritub väga kergesti. Sellest hoolimata püüab Monk oma tööd edasi teha, kuid sellel on ettearvamatud tagajärjed.

programme.title: Chicago politseijaoskond
programme.desc: Et vältida ohustavat jõugusõda, peavad Voight ja Ray Price korraldama rahukohtumise, et lõpetada verevalamine enne, kui süütud inimesed viga saavad. Burgess kaalub tulevikku Blairiga.

programme.title: Rängad kuriteod
programme.desc: LAPD toob olulise tunnistaja Los Angelesse tunnistusi andma. Sündmuste kohutav pööre toob kaasa selle, et tunnistajast saab hoopis uue mõrva peamine kahtlusalune.

programme.title: Mõrvaennetajad
programme.desc: Avahooajal USAs laineid löönud põnevussari salapärasest miljardärist, kes värbab endale appi endise CIA agendi, et ühiselt ennetada New Yorki ähvardavaid ränki kuritegusid. Pururikas geenius Finch ("Teadmata kadunud" staar Michael Emerson) on välja töötanud arvutiprogrammi, mis suudab tuvastada potentsiaalse mõrvari või tema ohvri veel enne selle kuriteo reaalset toimumist. Endine eriagent Reese (Jim Caviezel), kes pärast isiklikku tragöödiat elab New Yorkis kodutuna, on nõus Fichiga kampa lööma ja aitab Finchil huvipakkuva isiku üles leida. Reese'i ülesandeks jääb ka tulevase tapja kahjutuks tegemine. Loomulikult peab tandem tegutsema ülima saladuskatte all, sest nende info ja tegevuse paljastamise tagajärjed oleksid katastroofilised.

programme.title: Wong ja Winchester
programme.desc: Naine, kes kahtlustab, et tema kihlatu petab teda, palkab Marissa. Probleem on aga selles, et mees on tema endine elukaaslane Martin Simard.
